verdict.rationale: Daytona's pricing page and docs emphasize millisecond spin-up/teardown and 'use what you need, when you need it' with $200 free compute, implying usage-based billing rather than fixed-duration billing, but no evidence explicitly states per-second billing granularity or shows a rate card/pricing table confirming per-second metering. missing for 10: explicit per-second billing rate/documentation, independent confirmation of billing granularity, detailed pricing breakdown by resource type.
